answer.origin: The Diplomat (media), relaying a Singapore Police Force statement; the article is dated 2026-07-02 and the original statement day is not stated.
answer.note: Excluded under the research-scope instruction: the overview of this Singapore server-transshipment case is not kept as research evidence for NVIDIA. No NVIDIA business link, chip identity, sales, customer relationship, or end-user destination is drawn from it. The article itself says the servers only 'may have contained' Nvidia chips and that the ultimate destination is unclear.
limitations: Under the user exclusion, the case overview (charges, seized property, Singapore-to-Malaysia shipment, possible China destination) is not used as evidence about NVIDIA.

The source does not establish that any server contained NVIDIA chips, that NVIDIA sold to or had any relationship with the Aperia Group, Luxuriate Your Life, or the suppliers, or that NVIDIA bears any responsibility.
follow_up: Evaluate any separately sourced export-control news about NVIDIA chips on its own record; this case overview may not be used to support it.
